title: Cloud Data Integration and ETL Pipeline Development Services
raw_description: Saskatchewan Ministry of SaskBuilds seeks a data integration specialist to develop and maintain cloud ETL pipelines connecting 8 operational source systems (Oracle EBS, MS Dynamics, Salesforce) to a Snowflake data warehouse. Specific requirements: Apache Airflow or Azure Data Factory for orchestration, dbt for transformation layer, automated data quality checks, schema change monitoring, and incremental load logic. Deliverables: production pipeline code (Python), Airflow DAGs, dbt models, data dictionary, and runbook documentation. Must have proven Snowflake integration experience and CI/CD pipeline deployment on Azure DevOps.

ground_truth.rationale: Direct capability match — ETL, Snowflake, dbt, Airflow are Your Organization primary skills. Saskatchewan is adjacent to Your Organization's Alberta target market. $300K is a clean engagement size.
